> Index · Summit Az · 2026-10-13

# Summary
Index of Summit Arizona blog notes built from the root-level drafts, plans and trackers. Blog drafts and sources in the `blogs\` subfolder (June starter set, monsoon cluster, drain cluster and more) are covered in their own notes listed in [Summit AZ - Work Folders Index](lib:brain-summit-az-work-folders-index).

# Blog standards for Summit
- Author "Summit Plumbing Pros" (user ID 1). Categories: Plumbing Tips, Water Heaters, Drains & Sewers, Leaks & Pipes.
- Keyword research first (volume 100+, KD 0 to 30, Kim confirms); informational keywords only, never a service page's money term.
- Short answer first, question H2s, FAQ last with FAQPage plus BlogPosting schema, branded 1400x730 banner, no lead or comment form, publish one at a time. See [SEO Blog Writing Standards](lib:brain-seo-blog-writing-standards).
